title: Build a small sequential model
summary: A sequential model applies layers in order. An activation such as ReLU keeps positive values and changes negative values to zero.
introduction: A sequential model applies layers in order. An activation such as ReLU keeps positive values and changes negative values to zero. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain build a small sequential model
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A sequential model applies layers in order. An activation such as ReLU keeps positive values and changes negative values to zero.

blocks.code:
import torch

model = torch.nn.Sequential(torch.nn.Linear(2, 3), torch.nn.ReLU(), torch.nn.Linear(3, 1))
print(tuple(model(torch.tensor([[1.0, 2.0]])).shape))
blocks.title: Build a small sequential model

blocks.text: The model produces shape (1, 1). The middle layer lets the model represent more than one plain linear transformation.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Name the input and output size of each linear layer.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Adjacent layers must have compatible sizes.
